title: Sprouts
description:
A light-weight data lakehouse for open research information, built on DuckLake. Combines several open scholarly datasets — OpenAlex, the OpenAIRE Graph, Dutch institutional CRIS records, OpenAPC, and a Dutch-organisations reference table — into one queryable DuckLake catalog, plus a standalone browser app to explore it without installing anything.

Live, browsable view: https://surf-ori.github.io/sprouts/

Data sources loaded into the catalog
SchemaSourceDescription
openalexOpenAlexFully open catalog of the global research system (works, authors, institutions, funders, topics, …).
openaire, openaire-11.1.1OpenAIRE GraphAggregated European open-science graph (publications, datasets, software, organizations, projects, …). openaire-11.1.1 is a specific pinned Graph release.
crisDutch institutional CRIS systemsPublication metadata harvested via OAI-PMH from Dutch institutions' CRIS systems (Pure/DSpace), using the OpenAIRE CERIF profile.
openapcOpenAPCArticle/book processing charges (APCs/BPCs) and transformative-agreement costs, voluntarily reported by institutions.
nl-orgsSURF ORI baseline (Zenodo)Reference table of Dutch research organisations.
pid2portalDerived, computed in this repoOpenAlex/OpenAIRE works filtered to at least one author affiliated with a Dutch organisation — not a raw source.
